0.1: I'm going to profess my love for her today right here! \nI found an absolutely foolproof way to do it this time! \nIt's the #e#bcardiotachometer method#n#k! I've heard amazing testimonies about it!
0.2: #eThe way it works is, if I wait until her heart is beating quickly, like when she's scared or excited, then profess my love for her#n, she'll mistakenly think her heart is pounding because she likes me, and I'll succeed in confessing my love for her!\nIt's brilliant! Ingenious, really! But I had a really hard time obtaining the #b#ecardiotachometer#n#k to do it.
0.3: Now that I have this absolutely infallible method, I just need a bit of luck and performance talent. \nI think maybe the reason I've failed so many times before is because I'm not very confident. So, #e#h0##n, could you help me out and stand by my side, supporting me like the new best friend I know you want to be?

no.0: Denied again! How heartless! How could you do this to me?!

yes.0: Good. \nThis will be the perfect opportunity for you to learn some skills of your own!#n Hehe.
